title: Episode One of Trying Viral Instagram Food Products
intro: That i keep getting as ads so we have to try them :D using - chowmein cup noodles
caption:
Episode One of Trying Viral Instagram Food Products
that i keep getting as ads so we have to try them :D

using - @masterchow chowmein cup noodles

Nutrition: ( as mentioned on their label) 
C: 23 | F: 9 | P: 7
Calories: 290 ( serves 1 ) 
priced @ INR 65 per cup 

my review: its definately worth buying for sure, the flavours are unique to the instant cuppa noodle products and 100% more flavourful than the maggi one i grew up eating during college
only drawback i’d say is because they use atta noodles so it does have a textural difference like you know it isnt the regular noodle you would expect but i would say try it the flavours are 10/10 just the noodles you’d have to get use to!!!

SHARE with your friends that you need to try this with :)
